Hi Andre — great to connect earlier. Below is a concise post-call recap + an initial pricing & model-mix proposal so your procurement and engineering teams have something concrete to review. Please flag any constraints (PO timing, CCPA/SOC2 evidence needs) and I can route to our contracts/security folks.

Quick recap of your stated volumes: 25M tokens/mo → 120M tokens/mo in month 3 (search-heavy). Budget signal: $10k–$40k/mo.

Initial unit-econ / model mix (proposal):
- Target aggregate: $1,050 per 1M tokens (pilot target, final may vary with committed volume).
- Proposed per-model split by volume: chat 55%, embeddings 40%, rerank 5%.
- Per-model target $/1M tokens (indicative): chat = $1,150; embeddings = $850; rerank = $2,800.

Why this split: embeddings carry the retrieval cost for search — higher volume but lower per-token compute when quantized/embeddings-optimized. Chat handles session text and UI summaries (fewer total tokens but higher per-token cost due to autoregressive decoding). Rerank is intermittent but expensive per call; we keep it small.

Next steps I propose:
1) We share the attached one-pager (estimates) with procurement — I can also produce a more formal quote if you confirm expected month-1 and month-3 average token volumes.
2) If the $1,050/1M target is within range, we can offer a pilot discount structure (example: 10% off for a 3-month committed volume threshold OR a reserved capacity pricing discussion).
3) Technical: your engineers to share a quick sample traffic profile (seq lengths, % embedding calls vs chat calls) so we can firm per-model cost estimates.

Attaching: LumenAI_estimates.xlsx (high-level numbers) and a draft MAP for procurement review.

Would you like me to loop in our pricing lead for a short call tomorrow?

Best,
